clauses: Average rentals per film within each rating.
Average rentals per inventory copy within each rating.
Count distinct rented films per rating.
edited: Looking at how much each film rating gets rented (going from rentals through the inventory copy to the film), take the ratings that are above the average across ratings. Give me one row: the average figure for those ratings and how far above the overall average they are on average. No rounding. Count rental transactions per rating.

Looking at how much each film rating gets rented (going from rentals through the inventory copy to the film), take the ratings that are above the average across ratings. Give me one row: the average figure for those ratings and how far above the overall average they are on average. No rounding. Average rentals per film within each rating.

queries:
WITH rentals_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS overall_average
  FROM rentals_by_rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(r.rental_count) AS average_rentals,
  AVG(r.rental_count - a.overall_average) AS average_above_overall
FROM rentals_by_rating AS r
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS a
WHERE r.rental_count > a.overall_average

WITH film_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_count) AS average_rentals_per_film
  FROM film_rentals
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rentals_per_film) AS average_across_ratings
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ra.average_rentals_per_film) AS average_rentals_per_film,
  AVG(ra.average_rentals_per_film - oa.average_across_ratings) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ra.average_rentals_per_film > oa.average_across_ratings

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.rating,
    COUNT(r.rental_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inventory_id) AS rentals_per_copy
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  LEFT JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rentals_per_copy) AS overall_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ra.rentals_per_copy) AS average_rentals_per_copy,
  AVG(ra.rentals_per_copy - o.overall_average) AS average_above_overall
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ra.rentals_per_copy > o.overall_average

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS rented_films
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rented_films) AS average_rented_films
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(rc.rented_films) AS average_rented_films,
  AVG(rc.rented_films - o.average_rented_films) AS average_above_overall
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE rc.rented_films > o.average_rented_films
